description: A rotating sequential switch: eight holes on an inner ring and eight on an outer ring turn past one another, and a hole is connected to the holes it comes within range of

params.text: Sets how many holes on the inner ring are in use, 1 to 8
Sets how many holes on the outer ring are in use, 1 to 8

inputs.text: One of the eight holes on the inner ring: an input by default, feeding whichever holes on the outer ring have come within range of it, and switched to an output by right-clicking its button
One of the eight holes on the outer ring: an output by default, carrying whatever the inner-ring holes in range of it are sending, and switched to an input by right-clicking its button
Adds to the inner ring count knob, seven holes over the full 0-10V
Adds to the outer ring count knob, seven holes over the full 0-10V
Turns the whole inner ring, -10V to 10V carrying it one full turn backwards to one full turn forwards
Turns the whole outer ring, -10V to 10V carrying it one full turn backwards to one full turn forwards
Chooses which saved snapshot of ring positions and ranges is in use, 0-10V spread across the snapshots that exist

outputs.text: One of the eight holes on the outer ring: an output by default, carrying whatever the inner-ring holes in range of it are sending, and switched to an input by right-clicking its button
One of the eight holes on the inner ring: an input by default, feeding whichever holes on the outer ring have come within range of it, and switched to an output by right-clicking its button

notes: the working mode is chosen by clicking a letter of the word ATOMS on the panel: A, T, M and S each select one, and O selects the snapshot CV.
in attack mode, chosen with the A of ATOMS, a connection fades in over a few milliseconds so that switching does not click; it is the mode to use for audio.
in trigger mode, chosen with the T of ATOMS, an input hole with no cable counts as a steady 10V, which turns the rings into a gate sequencer with nothing patched in.
in mixer mode, chosen with the M of ATOMS, every input in range is summed into the output with its level set by how close the two holes are; it costs the most processing of the four.
in sample mode, chosen with the S of ATOMS, an output holds the last voltage it was given when its connection is lost rather than dropping to 0V.
right-click a ring to switch between dragging the holes to new positions and dragging them to set how far each one reaches; the reach is drawn as an arc.
the e- and e+ buttons spread the holes of a ring evenly; right-clicking one adds or removes a snapshot of the whole arrangement, and the small knob at the centre selects between the snapshots.
a hole beyond the number in use can be turned into a modulation port: drag from it onto a hole to have it drive that hole's position or reach, or read out the distance to its partner as 0-10V.
the maker marks this module as an alpha version in its own menu.
menu: hints — draws the on-panel prompts explaining what each gesture does
digits — numbers the holes on the drawing
animate — redraws the rings as they turn rather than only when something changes
audio-rate pairing — works out which holes are paired every sample instead of every few, which costs a lot more processing and is only needed when ring positions are modulated at audio rate
auto-equalize — spreads the holes evenly around a ring again whenever the number in use changes
